description: Single-panel bright-field transmission electron micrograph, labelled "(a)" in the top-left corner, with a black horizontal scale bar annotated "5 µm" in the bottom-left corner. The very wide 5 µm field of view indicates low-magnification (large-area) TEM/STEM imaging of a bulk-scale deformation structure rather than a nanoscale defect study. The imaged area contains several grains separated by dark, irregular and partly curved boundaries: a large bright central-to-lower-left grain traversed by wavy, cell-like and tangled dislocation arrangements that anastomose across the grain interior, with darker, more heavily dislocated bands running approximately diagonally across the left side. Heavy dark contrast fills the top-right and right-hand regions, where grain-boundary networks, overlapping grains and dense dislocation tangles make individual boundaries hard to separate. A straight, darker planar feature (thin band or boundary segment) cuts through the middle of the grain, roughly vertical at the centre of the frame. The overall impression is of a non-uniform, locally heterogeneous deformation microstructure — strongly dislocated regions adjacent to comparatively clean, lightly dislocated grain interiors — consistent with planar/banded slip or with a two-phase (austenite plus B2) microstructure deforming inhomogeneously. No axis, legend, phase label, diffraction pattern or numeric data are printed on the panel; only the "(a)" label and the 5 µm scale bar. No caption was supplied for this figure, so the panel's exact metallurgical assignment cannot be confirmed from the printed text.

observations.observation: The figure consists of one bright-field TEM micrograph labelled "(a)" in the top-left corner.
A black horizontal scale bar annotated "5 µm" is drawn in the bottom-left of the panel.
The field of view spans several grains (about 15-20 µm across at the printed scale), which is a low-magnification, large-area TEM overview rather than a high-resolution defect image.
Dense, wavy and cell-like dislocation tangles traverse the brighter central-lower-left grain, whereas the adjacent right-hand and top-right regions show darker, heavily dislocated contrast.
A straight, darker planar band runs roughly vertically through the centre of the frame, and diagonally oriented dark bands cross the left portion of the image.
No phase names, crystallographic indices, diffraction pattern, axis labels or numeric annotations are printed anywhere in the panel.
No caption was extracted for this figure, so the micrograph cannot be tied to a specific alloy grade, processing condition or deformation state from the figure text alone.

subfigures.description: Bright-field TEM micrograph with a 5 µm scale bar. Shows several grains; a large bright grain at centre-lower-left contains wavy, tangled and cell-like dislocation substructure, while darker, heavily dislocated grains/bands occupy the left diagonal band and the top-right and right regions. A straight darker planar band runs centrally. Only the panel label and the 5 µm scale bar are printed; no phase labels or captured values.
